cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.
